01 / The instrument

Generative by nature.
Playable by design.

Three musical languages—Standard, Cinematic and Neoclassical—bring fresh intention-specific patches and arrangements, with automatic expressive motion. One-press saving and the eight-track mixer keep exploration flowing.

01 / PATCH LIBRARY

Thirty sounds, infinite possibilities.

30 named patches, including warm bass, keys, harp, guitar, flutes, reeds, choirs, pads and six new FM timbres. Edit brightness, attack and release.

02 / LIVING ARRANGEMENTS

Eight musical roles.

Lead, bass, pads, harmony, piano, plucks, choir and drums form evolving parts with variable development pace, Freeze, locks and motif returns.

03 / RHYTHM

Nineteen drum kits.

19 drum kits including four added FM kits. Set density, 0–100% optional-hit probability, level and mix presence.

04 / FREQUENCY

Fine-tuned stereo.

Independent-ear binaural oscillators, selectable beat differences from 0.5 to 40 Hz, intention tones and optional 432/440 tuning. Headphones recommended.

05 / NATURE

An environment you can shape.

Evolving stereo birds, forests, and new Florida Night, Twilight Meadow, Crystal Creek and Mountain Rain nature beds.

06 / MIXER

The whole ensemble in view.

Redesigned eight-track console with focused channel strips, real peak meters, sends, mute, solo, Auto Level and Auto Gain.

07 / QUICK FIND

Eighty-six editable controls.

86 indexed on-device parameters, direct SOUND editing destinations, clearer knob values and intuitive navigation.

08 / VISUALS

Cymatics-inspired art.

Two visualizer modes, 13 expressive intention geometries, audio/onset response and immersive fullscreen.

09 / PERSONALIZE

Make it unmistakably yours.

Five panel skins, three AQUORA Sans sizes, black or white backgrounds, four lighting modes, four save banks and experimental AIR FX mapping.

AQUORA is a creative listening and musical instrument, not a medical treatment. Intention and frequency names are artistic listening themes, not claims of established healing effects. AIR sensing is experimental and physical response varies.

02 / Captured on the firmware renderer

Small screen.
A world of detail.

Seven authentic 240 × 240 interface captures from the accepted v0.6.4 renderer. SOUND, EVOLVE and mixer graphs show four seconds of real audio-active frames; AIR and other settings remain still.

03 / Why AQUORA exists

The poetry of resonance.

AQUORA is an independent creative work built around musical curiosity, movement, and the beauty of patterns in nature.

Water & cymatics

Ripples, symmetry, interference and crystalline motifs inform the visual language. Masaru Emoto's imagery is a *visual inspiration*, not scientific evidence of water remembering emotion.

THEMES / WAVEFORMS / LIGHT

Ambient instruments

Slow drones, layered acoustic colors, evolving melodic fragments and generative arrangement techniques shape the sonic identity.

THEMES / STILLNESS / MOVEMENT

Independent creative design

Readable typography, expressive controls and original visual ideas make AQUORA a personal musical world.

INDEPENDENT DESIGN / CREATIVITY
04 / A real instrument in your browser

Turn it on.
Let it evolve.

Not a video, not a static mockup. The emulator runs the completed AQUORA 0.6.4 FM-1 application compiled to WebAssembly, with live audio and the virtual instrument's knobs, buttons, keys and display.

Tap “Switch on” in the embedded emulator, then press PLAY on its virtual panel. For the most room to perform, open the dedicated emulator page.

site/README.md:
# AQUORA v0.6.4 showcase

Source branch aquora-showcase-site; static publication gh-pages. Website code
preserves the existing headline, AQUORA Sans companion fonts, actual emulator,
Studio bridge, installer route and native240px eight-screen4-second slideshow.

Accepted host source: run42085609310, unchanged firmware inputs2eaea586.
Final release acceptance and tag are pinned by the publication workflow.
Four audio-active APNGs (SOUND, EVOLVE, MIXER, focus strip) contain successive
real240×240 firmware LCD frames,4seconds/10fps, with provenance JSON and PNG
fallback. Other settings including AIR remain honest stills. Reduced-motion
preferences select PNGs; all image paths have load-failure fallback.

No standalone visualizer images or clips are copied into public assets.
The workflow whitelists eight PNGs and four APNGs, validates dimensions/duration,
checks actual release/WASM bytes and publishes independent GitHub backups.
Live deployment proof is recorded after publication, never inferred from source.
Physical flashing/listening/performance remain owner verification.
name: AQUORA public showcase
on:
  push:
    branches: [aquora-showcase-site]
    paths: ['site/**', '.github/workflows/aquora-showcase-pages.yml']
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: write
  actions: read
concurrency:
  group: aquora-public-showcase-publisher
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  build-and-publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Construct public site from published, accepted v0.6.4 assets
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          out="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/dist"
          rel="$RUNNER_TEMP/aquora-064"
          screens="$RUNNER_TEMP/aquora-panels"
          mkdir -p "$out/emu" "$out/studio" "$out/install" "$out/assets" "$rel" "$screens"
          gh release download v0.6.4 -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" -p AQUORA-0.6.4-package.tar.gz -D "$RUNNER_TEMP"
          gh release download v0.6.4 -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" -p SHA256SUMS.txt -D "$RUNNER_TEMP"
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP" && grep ' AQUORA-0.6.4-package.tar.gz$' SHA256SUMS.txt | sha256sum --check --strict)
          test "$(gh api repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/ref/tags/v0.6.4 --jq .object.sha)" = 50b8a1e02e215aff1e0a7b738d40f63769d4f502
          tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/AQUORA-0.6.4-package.tar.gz" -C "$rel"
          test -s "$rel/emu/app.wasm"
          test -s "$rel/emu/worklet.js"
          cp -a "$rel/emu/." "$out/emu/"
          python3 site/tools/patch_emu.py "$out/emu/index.html"
          cp site/index.html site/style.css site/screen-carousel.js "$out/"
          cp site/studio/index.html "$out/studio/"
          cp site/install/index.html "$out/install/"
          cp site/assets/favicon.svg "$out/assets/"
          cp site/fonts/OFL.txt "$out/assets/OFL.txt"
          python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/aquora-site-font-venv"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/aquora-site-font-venv/bin/pip" install --disable-pip-version-check --quiet "fonttools[woff]>=4.55,<5" "brotli>=1.1,<2" Pillow==11.3.0
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/aquora-site-font-venv/bin/python" site/tools/build_web_font.py site/fonts/InterTight-source.ttf "$out/assets"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/aquora-site-font-venv/bin/python" - "$out" <<'PYFONT'
          from pathlib import Path
          from fontTools.ttLib import TTFont
          from sys import argv
          output = Path(argv[1])
          for filename, weight in (("aquora-sans-regular.woff2", 560), ("aquora-sans-bold.woff2", 720)):
              path=output/"assets"/filename
              assert path.read_bytes()[:4] == b"wOF2" and path.stat().st_size > 10000
              font=TTFont(path)
              assert font["name"].getDebugName(1) == "AQUORA Sans"
              assert font["OS/2"].usWeightClass == weight
          css=(output/"style.css").read_text()
          assert "font-family:'AQUORA Sans'" in css
          assert "fonts.googleapis.com" not in css
          assert (output/"assets"/"OFL.txt").exists()
          print("Verified two genuine AQUORA Sans WOFF2 fonts and licensing")
          PYFONT
          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/aquora-site-font-venv/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/aquora-site-font-venv/bin:$PATH"
          gh run download 42085609310 -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" -n aquora-064-host-panel -D "$screens"
          cp "$screens/captures064/"*-064.png "$out/assets/"
          cp "$screens/captures064/"*-064.apng "$out/assets/"
          cp "$screens/captures064/provenance.json" "$out/assets/animation-provenance.json"
          touch "$out/.nojekyll"
          cat > "$out/PROVENANCE.txt" <<'EOF'
          AQUORA v0.6.4 website sourced from accepted release.
          Firmware commit 50b8a1e02e215aff1e0a7b738d40f63769d4f502
          CI run https://github.com/CodingSlapfu/AQUORA/actions/runs/42087112438
          Eight v0.6.4 interface captures, four real audio-active APNGs; no standalone visualizer screenshots.
          AQUORA Sans web vector faces derived from the matching OFL firmware font.
          Published WASM byte-for-byte unchanged; Studio adapter affects HTML only.
          EOF
          cmp "$rel/emu/app.wasm" "$out/emu/app.wasm"
          node -e 'const f=require("fs");new WebAssembly.Module(f.readFileSync("dist/emu/app.wasm"));console.log("WASM valid")'
          node --check "$out/screen-carousel.js"
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from html.parser import HTMLParser
          from pathlib import Path
          import struct
          d=Path("dist")
          assert "AQUORA Studio companion bridge" in (d/"emu/index.html").read_text()
          assert "AQUORA_STUDIO" in (d/"studio/index.html").read_text()
          installer=(d/"install/index.html").read_text()
          home=(d/"index.html").read_text()
          studio=(d/"studio/index.html").read_text()
          target="https://parallax8-studio.jminie66.chatgpt.site/install/"
          release="https://github.com/CodingSlapfu/AQUORA/releases/tag/v0.6.4"
          assert 'href="install/"' in home and 'href="../install/"' in studio
          assert 'src="'+target+'"' in installer
          assert 'href="'+target+'"' in installer
          assert 'href="'+release+'"' in installer
          assert 'allow="midi; midi-sysex; usb"' in installer
          assert 'v0.6.4' in installer
          assert 'Some browsers block MIDI access' in installer
          print("Verified showcase installer route and original MIDI service fallback")
          for name in ("play","sound","evolve","mixer","mix-strip","drums","air","appearance"):
              raw=(d/"assets"/(name+"-064.png")).read_bytes()
              assert raw[:8]==b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"
              assert struct.unpack(">II",raw[16:24])==(240,240)
          class P(HTMLParser): pass
          for f in (d/"index.html",d/"studio/index.html",d/"install/index.html",d/"emu/index.html"):
              P().feed(f.read_text())
          import re
          forbidden=re.compile(r"(?i)M-VAVE|HYP-1|ChoralRoot|Sony|Sega|0\.6\.1")
          for file in d.rglob("*"):
              if file.is_file() and file.suffix in (".html",".css",".js",".svg",".txt"):
                  assert forbidden.search(file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) is None, file
          expected={name+"-064.png" for name in ("play","sound","evolve","mixer","mix-strip","drums","air","appearance")}
          assert {file.name for file in (d/"assets").glob("*.png")} == expected
          assert all(name in (d/"index.html").read_text() for name in expected)
          carousel=(d/"screen-carousel.js").read_text()
          assert 'id="hero-screen-carousel"' in (d/"index.html").read_text()
          assert 'id="hero-screen-image"' in (d/"index.html").read_text()
          assert 'screen-carousel.js' in (d/"index.html").read_text()
          assert all(name in carousel for name in expected), "slideshow is missing an accepted screen"
          withheld=("polar-064.png","original-064.png","polar-062.png","original-062.png")
          assert all(name not in (d/"index.html").read_text() for name in withheld)
          assert all(name not in carousel for name in withheld)
          assert all(not (d/"assets"/name).exists() for name in withheld)
          print("Verified both visualizer screenshots omitted from all website assets and showcases")
          assert 'VISIBLE MUSIC' not in (d/"index.html").read_text()
          assert 'Evolving soundscapes.' in (d/"index.html").read_text()
          assert 'Tuned to your intention.' in (d/"index.html").read_text()
          assert 'to feel like water' not in (d/"index.html").read_text()
          assert 'hero-screen-toolbar' not in (d/"index.html").read_text()
          assert 'hero-screen-previous' not in (d/"index.html").read_text()
          assert 'hero-screen-next' not in (d/"index.html").read_text()
          assert 'hero-screen-pause' not in (d/"index.html").read_text()
          assert 'window.setInterval(advance, 4000)' in carousel
          assert 'document.hidden' in carousel
          css=(d/"style.css").read_text()
          assert ".hero-screen-stage{width:min(100%,240px);max-width:240px}" in css
          assert ".hero-play-screen{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:1/1;object-fit:contain;border:0;" in css
          assert "transform:rotateY" not in css
          print("Verified screenshot displayed at native 240px without upscaling or inset border")
          print("Verified automatic eight-screen slideshow without controls or obsolete hero label")
          print("Verified 8 current 0.6.4 interface captures including PLAY hero and public text")
          import json,hashlib
          from PIL import Image
          provenance=json.loads((d/"assets/animation-provenance.json").read_text())
          assert len(provenance)==4
          for item in provenance:
              path=d/"assets"/(item["page"]+"-064.apng")
              with Image.open(path) as im:
                  assert im.size==(240,240) and im.n_frames>=6
                  assert sum(im.seek(n) or im.info.get("duration",0) for n in range(im.n_frames))==4000
              assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==item["sha256"]
              assert item["unique_frames"]>5 and item["transport"]=="PLAY"
          assert {x.name for x in (d/"assets").glob("*.apng")}=={x["page"]+"-064.apng" for x in provenance}
          assert 'prefers-reduced-motion' in carousel and 'data-animated' in home
          print("Verified genuine live APNGs, provenance, static fallback and reduced motion")
          PY
          (cd "$out"; find . -type f ! -name SITE-SHA256SUMS.txt -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > SITE-SHA256SUMS.txt)
      - name: Archive matching public-site build
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: aquora-site-stable-064
          path: dist/
          include-hidden-files: true
          retention-days: 90
      - name: Push verified static site to the separate public gh-pages branch
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/site-publication"
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/site-publication"
          git init -q
          git config user.name "aquora-site-publisher"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git remote add origin "https://x-access-token:${GH_TOKEN}@github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}.git"
          if git ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin gh-pages >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            git fetch --depth 1 origin gh-pages
            git checkout -b gh-pages FETCH_HEAD
          else
            git checkout --orphan gh-pages
          fi
          find . -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 ! -name .git -exec rm -rf {} +
          cp -a "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/dist/." .
          git add -A
          if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git commit -m "site: AQUORA v0.6.4 playable showcase and studio"
            git push origin HEAD:gh-pages
          fi
      - name: Report branch publication and external Pages deployment
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "Generated site branch: https://github.com/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/tree/gh-pages"
          echo "GitHub Pages is configured for branch publishing (gh-pages / root). The native Pages deployment is handled separately."
          echo "The Pages service tracks gh-pages independently; verify its native pages build and public browser behavior before claiming complete browser acceptance."
